Name: Sign.Report.Query.Declare
Content:
select @sign$ID = &Sign.Function.Code;, @sign$Type = &Sign.Function.Type;
select top 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, nh_kho, ma_kho, ma_bp, tk, ma_nk, [user_id], cast(0 as smalldatetime) as ngay_ky, cast(0 as int) as nguoi_lap into #signKey from dmttckct

Name: GLTranReportSql
Content:
if @@form in ('810', '820', '821', '822', '830', '840', '850', '860') begin
	declare @formTypeGL tinyint
	if @@form in ('821', '822', '850', '860') set @formTypeGL = 1 else set @formTypeGL = 0
	exec rs_GLTranReport @stt_rec, @@id, 'r00$$partition$current', @@language, @formTypeGL
end

Name: Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Select.Filter
Content:
select @$unit$Parameter = cast(@$ma_dvcs as varchar(8000))


select @sign$ID = @@id, @sign$Type = '0'
select top 0 ma_dvcs, ma_ct, loai_ct, nh_kho, ma_kho, ma_bp, tk, ma_nk, [user_id], cast(0 as smalldatetime) as ngay_ky, cast(0 as int) as nguoi_lap into #signKey from dmttckct



exec dbo.FastBusiness$App$Print$GetSignKey '', @sign$ID, '$partition$current', @sign$Type, @$unit$Parameter output, @@language, @@userID, @@admin
